texts.preamble: Anisur Almulla And Another vs State Of U.P. on 1 May, 2023 Author: Vivek Kumar Singh Bench: Vivek Kumar Singh High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad ?Court No. - 86 Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 15311 of 2023 Applicant :- Anisur Almulla And Another Opposite Party :- State of U.P. Counsel for Applicant :- Lakshman Tripathi
texts.arguments: It has been contended by the learned counsel for the applicants that the applicants have been falsely implicated in the present case due to ulterior motive. It is next contended that the applicants have not committed the alleged offence. There is no any independent witness of the alleged recovery. The co-accused Sameer Khan and Safi Khan have been granted bail by co-ordinate Bench of this Court vide order dated 27.03.2023 in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.10754 of 2023, therefore, the applicant is also entitled for bail, therefore, the applicants are also entitled for bail. Several other submissions in order to demonstrate the falsity of the allegations made against the applicants have also been placed forth before the Court. The circumstances which, according to the counsel, led to the false implication of the accused has also been touched upon at length. It has been assured on behalf of the applicants that they are ready to cooperate with the process of law and shall faithfully make themselves available before the court whenever required. It has also been submitted that the Anisur Almulla And Another vs State Of U.P. on 1 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/195978359/ 1 applicants are languishing in jail since 6.1.2018. It has been pointed out that the applicants have no previous criminal history. Learned A.G.A. opposed the prayer for bail but could not dispute the aforesaid facts.
